land_pattern.package: SOIC-8, TI D0008A 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT / LAND PATTERN EXAMPLE' (drawing 4214825/C, 02/2019)
land_pattern.notes: From the RECOMMENDED land pattern drawing (page 51, 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT'), not the package outline: 8X (.061) [1.55] mm pad length (along the lead axis, horizontal in the drawing), 8X (.024) [0.6] mm pad width, 6X (.050) [1.27] mm pad-to-pad pitch within a row, (.213) [5.4] mm between the two pad rows measured centre-to-centre, (R.002) [0.05] mm typ pad corner radius. Pads are numbered 1-4 down the left column and 5-8 up the right column with SYMM centrelines both ways. Drawing note 6: 'Publication IPC-7351 may have alternate designs.' Note 7: solder-mask tolerances between and around signal pads vary by board fab site. Solder-mask details: non-solder-mask-defined = .0028 MAX [0.07] mm all around; solder-mask-defined = .0028 MIN [0.07] mm all around. Stencil (page 52, 'EXAMPLE STENCIL DESIGN'): same 8X 1.55 x 0.6 mm apertures at 1.27 mm pitch, based on a .005 inch [0.125 mm] thick stencil, 1:1 with the pads (no paste reduction). NO courtyard excess is stated in the drawing, so courtyard_excess_mm is deliberately omitted.
